FETCHED AND DIFFED, nothing to merge — upstream has not re-run since 2026-09-01, so this is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED (2026-08-21) and not a fetch failure. Both plain curl calls to the JSON API succeeded (the HTML page and r.jina.ai were correctly not used): manifest.json reports completedAt 2026-09-01T22:25:20Z / snapshotDate 2026-09-01, and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json returned 161,730 bytes with Last-Modified "Tue, 01 Sep 2026 22:23:28 GMT". Those two agree, so this is NOT the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest shape, but the payload was diffed anyway rather than trusted to the manifest. Selection whitelisted categoryType in {dps, hps, tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined out of the 44 blocks — never merely blacklisting "dungeon", because melee and ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs — giving 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched (classSpec.className/.spec are byte-identical to the roster). Diff against stored: moved 0 / same 40 / new 0, with value, n and asOf all compared at the stored 1-decimal precision. Nothing merged, so the coverage date correctly did not move; partial rather than success because the source's own snapshotDate is 5 days behind this run and success requires a stored date within 1 day. maxAgeDays 8 was NOT raised and no ack was proposed — it clears when WoWMeta re-runs. The raid endpoint was not touched (its lowerBound is DPS throughput, a different quantity on a different scale).

This is a standing structural gap, not an outage: WoW dps/hps API access works fine — the collector spent 654.56 of 3,600 points over 138 successful GraphQL queries this run — and rdps is FFXIV-only in the official schema, so its rejection is not a WoW-outage diagnostic and the older 'rDPS outage' framing was wrong. The new per-encounter leaderboard series is a SEPARATE requirement measuring a different quantity and cannot green this aggregate row. Public statistics pages still return verification challenges; no bypass, proxy or challenge replay was attempted.

Row count 23 is above the 15 floor and no rows dropped. Success is claimable because the stored coverage date 2026-09-05 is within one day of run 2026-09-06.
